claims.claim_text: The indexed French S/Lt Rene Veuve is strongly matched to Rene Joyeuse, whom the CIA identifies as born Rene Veuve and later assigned that OSS codename.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index supplies the exact birth name, French note, junior-officer rank, and Box 804; the CIA explicitly connects Veuve to the OSS name Joyeuse.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact distinctive birth name plus matching French wartime context, officer indication, and an explicit institutional birth-name-to-OSS-name linkage.
claims.temporal_assessment: The CIA places Free French and Resistance work after 1940 and before OSS service.
claims.match_notes: High confidence rather than confirmed because the indexed Box 804 personnel file has not been reviewed.

claims.evidence_excerpt: continued working with the French Resistance and joined the OSS

claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match from exact birth name, French index note, officer indication, and explicit OSS alias history.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly immediate in sequence, though no transfer date or formal Resistance status is given.
claims.match_notes: The relationship is marked unknown rather than inferring employment, volunteering, or a formal military assignment.

claims.temporal_assessment: The CIA chronology places Army and OWI service before later OSS work.
